title: Development of a Platform for Booking Rooms in Hotels and Motels Across Kyrgyzstan
content: The main purpose of this project is to develop an application called "Checkpoint.kg" which is supported by every web browser. Its goal is to provide a website where users will be able to book rooms in a hotel from anywhere in Kyrgyzstan. The uniqueness of this diploma work is that the website will not only provide tourist clients a user friendly service for booking rooms but also gives local residents an opportunity to develop small businesses by registering their small hotels, apartments, guesthouses to the website. The backend of the website was built using NodeJs (powerful Javascript runtime environment for backend development) and the frontend was built using ReactJs (popular JavaScript library for developing user interfaces).
